summary: Homefront entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Homefront
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC Steam release with fix and multiplayer/server state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with documented settings

primary.why: The PC route is the best capture path for the original 2011 campaign. Console multiplayer servers shut down after THQ's collapse, while PC multiplayer requires exact current server/community state documentation.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam PC build. Record build, resolution/FOV/fix state, input, campaign difficulty, DLC/map ownership, multiplayer browser/server state, and whether PS3/Xbox 360 were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for console performance or historical multiplayer documentation.
secondary.why: PC is the best capture route and console online state is shut down/historical.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not confuse with Homefront: The Revolution, which is a separate sequel/reboot.
